title: Heaven
definition: Heaven is the blessed presence of God where believers are with Christ and await the fullness of resurrection and new creation.
summary: Heaven is the blessed presence of God where believers are with Christ and await the fullness of resurrection and new creation.
christFocus: Jesus prepares a place for His people and brings them to the Father.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Heaven places present life under the future God has promised. The hope of heaven centers on being with the lord, not merely escaping pain.

Scripture teaches the last things to produce hope, holiness, endurance, and urgency rather than speculation. People may long for relief but need the greater hope of fellowship with god through christ.

Christ stands at the center of this future. Jesus prepares a place for His people and brings them to the Father. Because of Him, believers can face death, judgment, suffering, and the future with sober confidence rather than fear.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
The coming future exposes what truly matters now. People may long for relief but need the greater hope of fellowship with god through christ. Scripture’s teaching about the last things steadies the heart in a world that feels unfinished.

It also guards the Church from fear-based prophecy and careless delay. The Lord calls His people to watchfulness, holiness, comfort, mission, and trust.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Set your heart on Christ and the home He has promised. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
